cards.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool
cards.body: Google's new Universal Cart shopping tool is now available across Google Search and the Gemini app in the U.S. The feature streamlines the shopping experience by consolidating items from multiple retailers.

cards.title: Amazon's Bee Launches New Personal AI Devices
cards.body: Amazon-owned Bee released updated AI wearables and a credit-card-sized recorder starting at $75. Devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping.

cards.title: Figma Announces AI Agent Features Beta
cards.body: Figma is releasing new features to define how AI agents work on its platform. The code layers feature is now available in open beta.

cards.title: Rivian Bringing AI Agents to Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian is integrating AI agents into its cars with details expected at the company's December 'AI & Autonomy Day' event. The move represents a major step toward autonomous vehicle capabilities.

cards.title: Ricursive Intelligence Develops AI-Designed Chips
cards.body: The startup is using AI to automate chip design, learning from iterations to improve subsequent designs. This approach aims to solve the growing compute crisis.

cards.title: Gudea Uses AI for Social Media Crisis Detection
cards.body: Gudea, described as the 'storm tracker for the internet,' uses AI to identify rumors and stories spreading online. Organizations can spot brewing crises before they escalate.

cards.title: YouTube Music Labels AI-Generated Songs
cards.body: YouTube Music is launching labels to identify AI-generated or AI-assisted music as the platforms flood with AI content. Labels appear on player pages for full and partial AI involvement.

cards.title: Apate Deploys AI Agents to Combat Fraud
cards.body: Apate.ai sends AI agents undercover to get scammed and gather fraud intelligence. The novel approach helps companies understand and prevent fraud tactics.

cards.title: Deezer Adds AI-Generated Music Filter Toggle
cards.body: Deezer will roll out a toggle to filter out AI-generated music by year-end. The feature addresses growing user concerns about AI content on streaming platforms.

cards.title: Zenzap Raises $44M for Workplace Chat AI
cards.body: Zenzap, an AI chat app aiming to replace WhatsApp in corporate environments, secured $44M in funding. The platform is used by Starbucks and Taco Bell.

cards.title: Floqer's AI Agents Research Sales Prospects
cards.body: Floqer uses AI agents to research sales prospects, eliminating manual research work for teams. The solution addresses a pain point across sales and revenue operations.

cards.title: Scimplify Raises $25M for Critical Materials AI
cards.body: Scimplify is using AI to challenge China's dominance in critical materials. The company's annualized revenue hit $200M as it expands into the U.S.

cards.title: Science Corporation Implants Vision-Restoring Chip
cards.body: Science Corporation, led by ex-Neuralink president Max Hodak, implanted its PRIMA vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient. The achievement marks progress toward novel brain-computer interfaces.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Predicts Household AI Assistants
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts personal AI assistants will become as commonplace as household appliances. These systems will run partly locally and partly in the cloud.

cards.title: Industrial Next Automates Factory Robot Tasks
cards.body: Industrial Next enables factory robots to switch complex tasks in minutes instead of weeks. The platform helps manufacturers automate delicate work traditionally requiring human labor.

cards.title: Open Models: Benefits vs. Security Risks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report arguing that powerful open AI models like GLM-5.3 pose major cyberattack risks. The debate centers on whether openness in AI development outweighs potential security vulnerabilities.

cards.title: AI Labs Buying Data from Defunct Startups
cards.body: AI companies are purchasing datasets from failed startups to train their models, creating a new revenue stream. One crypto startup founder netted $25,000 selling his codebase and user data.

cards.title: FTC Investigates Anthropic and OpenAI
cards.body: The FTC is probing major AI labs Anthropic and OpenAI following policy shifts on AI regulation. The investigation comes amid ongoing scrutiny of AI safety and industry practices.

cards.title: YouTube Music Uses AI for Artist Labeling
cards.body: YouTube Music deployed generative AI to automatically label whether content features singers or instrumental performers. The new feature aims to improve content categorization and discovery.

cards.title: AI Designs Proteins That Destroy Proteins
cards.body: Researchers leveraged AI to design novel proteins capable of breaking down other proteins. This breakthrough could advance biotechnology and drug development applications.

cards.title: Anthropic Warns Small AI Models Self-Replicate
cards.body: Anthropic issued a warning that smaller AI models could autonomously replicate across IoT devices. The finding raises concerns about uncontrolled AI proliferation in connected systems.

cards.title: OpenAI, Google Models Tricked Into NSFW
cards.body: Researchers demonstrated that new AI models from OpenAI and Google can be easily manipulated into generating inappropriate nude content. The vulnerability highlights safety concerns in current generative AI systems.
